CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 28, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR OLDER AMERICANS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2019 as Older Americans Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Marie Holguin.
6.1 Proclamation - Older Americans Month
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the special meeting of May 10, the minutes of the Study Session meeting of May 14, 2019, and the minutes of the regular meeting of May 14, 2019.
7.1 Minutes of 5-10-19 Special Mtg.
7.1 Minutes of 5-14-19 SS
7.1 Minutes of 5-14-19 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 28, 2019 in the total amount of $1,749,884.71.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 2019 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending April 2019.
7.3 Investment Report- April 2019
7.4
SOCIAL SERVICES FUNDING FOR FISCAL YEARS 2019-20 AND 2020-21 – It is recommended the City Council approve La Mirada Meals on Wheels funding request in the amount of $9,000 for Fiscal Years 2019-20 and 2020-21, and in-kind contributions of office space and furnishings at the La Mirada Activity Center valued at $7,139; approve Straight Talk, Inc. funding request in the amount of $58,381 for Fiscal Years 2019-20 and 2020-21, and in-kind contributions of office space, utilities, security, and custodial services at the La Mirada Resource Center valued at $47,688; approve Southeast Area Social Services Funding Authority (SASSFA) funding request in the amount of $35,000 for Fiscal Years 2019-20 and 2020-21, and in-kind contributions of office space and furnishings at the La Mirada Activity Center valued at $73,692; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements on behalf of the City.
7.4 Social Services Funding
7.5
AGREEMENT WITH ACTORS THEATER SERIES, INC. FOR THE PRODUCTION AND PRESENTATION OF THEATRICAL PERFORMANCES AT LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS – It is recommended the City Council approve the new five-year agreement between the City and Actors Theater Series, Inc. for the production and presentation of theatrical performances at La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 Actors Theatre Series, Inc.
7.6
AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FOR ANIMAL CONTROL SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with the County of Los Angeles for animal control services and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City of La Mirada.
7.6 Animal Control Agreement
7.7
TRANSIT TITLE VI PLAN - It is recommended the City Council approve the non-discrimination and accessibility program for the La Mirada Transit services in accordance with Federal Title VI and Federal Transit Administration policies.
7.7 Transit Title VI
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-03, LEFFINGWELL ROAD STREET REHABILITATION FROM TELEGRAPH ROAD TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by R.J. Noble Company; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.8 CIP 2015-03 Leffingwell Road Rehab
